# All About Seoul

> > All About Seoul (AAS) is a luxury medical tourism concierge specializing in VIP plastic surgery, cosmetic procedures, and premium healthcare experiences in Seoul's premier districts including Gangnam, Apgujeong, and Itaewon.

Operated by JABEZ Ltd. under the direction of GI HEE KIM, All About Seoul connects international clients with Korea's world-renowned cosmetic surgery clinics and medical facilities. The service combines advanced aesthetic procedures with personalized VIP care, luxury accommodations, and cultural experiences across Seoul's most prestigious neighborhoods.
